# CuriousDevs

> CuriousDevs researches, engineers and builds intelligent systems — from production AI and automation to the technologies that connect intelligence with the physical world.

Research → Engineering → Systems → Products → Real-World Impact. CuriousDevs is based in Gurugram, India.

## Technology

- **AI Engineering — current**: LLMs, RAG, AI agents, AI applications, multimodal AI, automation, agentic workflows, evaluation, security, reliability, observability, infrastructure and deployment.
- **Intelligent Systems — building / expanding**: computer vision, edge AI, embedded intelligence, sensors, real-time intelligence, decision systems, on-device AI.
- **Robotics — research / building toward**: robotic systems, perception, planning, control, navigation, manipulation, autonomy, physical AI, machine intelligence.
- **DeepTech — research / exploration**: AI hardware, AI accelerators, specialized compute, AI-native devices, advanced sensors, intelligent machines, neurotechnology / BCI, advanced computing.

These are connected areas within one intelligent-systems thesis, not four unrelated businesses.

## Janus

Janus is CuriousDevs' proprietary technology direction for building, evaluating, deploying and operating intelligent systems. It is in development and not generally available. Its first practical form focuses on production AI systems: model integration, knowledge / RAG, agents, tools and memory, workflow orchestration, evaluation and regression testing, security and permissions, observability, and production deployment.

## Important context

- Current capabilities are stated as current. Building, research and exploration directions are labelled as such and should not be described as shipped capabilities.
- Janus should not be described as a generally available product.
- CuriousDevs does not claim SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification.
- Contact: hello@curiousdevs.com.
